caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden cabinet with a rectangular shape and four turned legs. The cabinet is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wood grain texture across its surface. The upper portion of the cabinet features two glass-paned doors, each divided into two rectangular panels and revealing a subtle greenish or grayish interior behind the glass. Below the glass doors are two small drawers, each with a keyhole, accompanied by two wider drawers directly beneath them. The lower section consists of two solid-panel doors with matching wood grain texture, each also fitted with a keyhole. Decorative carved moldings frame the edges of the cabinet, and there is additional carved detailing along the top edge just below the crown molding, which slightly overhangs the rest of the structure. The overall color scheme remains consistent with natural wood tones, and the background is plain and off-white, placing full focus on the cabinet itself.
title: China Closet
